meta.evaluation_title: PS-03 Head-to-Head LLM Monitoring Evaluation: Go vs Python
meta.trial_design: 20 warmup excluded, 20 baseline-profile, 20 trials x 5 scenarios (200 candidate trials total)

real_model_quantization_evidence.empirical_conclusion: Switching from Q8_0 to Q4_K_M induces an empirical 8.4% accuracy regression localized to mathematics and complex logical reasoning, while increasing generation throughput by 14.6%.
